comments.body: In the future combining the team creation and release repository creation requests into one issue like #824 is sufficient.

comments.author: jmachowinski
comments.body: @nuclearsandwich I followed https://docs.ros.org/en/kilted/How-To-Guides/Releasing/First-Time-Release.html this guide. As this are two separate items in the guide I opened two issues... Should we put a hint in the guide that this can be done as one step ?
